title: Start my gym promises 3 free months, but a mobile number that already had a trial gets none
what: The line above the Start my gym form says 'Free for 3 months. No card.' When the WhatsApp number check is used and that number already had a trial or already owns a gym, the server gives the new gym no trial at all. The owner then lands on a banner saying the free trial has already ended today.
expected: The form says the 3 free months are for a first gym only, or the owner is told before Create my gym that this number has already had its trial.
who: new gym owners who open a second gym or start again
how_often: each time a checked number makes another gym
fix_line: Say on the form that the free months are once per mobile number, and say so again when none are given

title: The alerts setting lists what always comes at once, but leaves out join requests and web page questions
what: Settings tells the owner and desk that only complaints, shop orders, a member at the check-in poster, a friend who wants to join and a near-end pause or renew request come at once, and that the rest follow their daily or weekly time. A person asking to join online (paid or not) and a web page visitor's question are also sent at once, whatever time was picked.
expected: The 'always come at once' list names every kind that is sent at once.
who: owners and desk staff who pick daily or weekly alerts
how_often: every join request and web page question
fix_line: Add join requests and web page questions to the 'always at once' line

title: Personal training is counted in 'sessions' on one screen and in 'classes' on another
what: A member's personal training line reads 'PT: 3 of 10 sessions used', while the trainer page and its booking messages say 'personal-training classes left' and 'classes already booked' for the same thing. 'PT' is also used without being spelled out.
expected: One word for one personal training visit everywhere, written in full.
how_often: every time personal training is shown
fix_line: Pick 'sessions' or 'classes' and use it on every personal training screen

title: In Hinglish, the numbers to confirm and app request cards, Member messages, alerts settings, desk photo and workout offer stay in English
what: The panel offers Hinglish, but a line with no Hinglish version simply shows in English. Most sentences of these screens have none: numbers to confirm 9 of 9, app plan requests 15 of 15, Member messages 27 of 31, alerts on this device 31 of 42, desk photo 11 of 11, workout offer 17 of 18, trainer pages 33 of 34, web page chat 9 of 9. The numbers-to-confirm card does not even pass its words through the language step.
expected: Every line on a screen shows in the language the person picked.
who: owners and desk staff who chose Hinglish
fix_line: Add Hinglish lines for these screens and pass every card's words through the language step

title: The alert timing and Bring a friend Save buttons are greyed when nothing changed, with no word that it is already saved
what: When the owner opens the alert timing card or the Bring a friend free days box, Save is greyed out. 'Saved.' shows only right after a save in this visit, so on a fresh visit the owner sees a dead button and no reason.
expected: Next to a greyed Save the screen says it is already saved, or what to change first.
how_often: every visit to these two settings
fix_line: Show 'Saved' or 'Nothing changed yet' next to a greyed Save

title: The test alert says it can take up to a minute, but the card waits a minute and a half
what: While a test alert is on its way the card says 'It can take up to a minute.' The card keeps waiting for 90 seconds before it says anything else, and the update note says 'about a minute and a half'.
expected: The waiting line gives the same time the card really waits.
who: owners and desk staff testing alerts
how_often: each test alert that takes over a minute
fix_line: Change the waiting line to 'up to a minute and a half'

title: Start my gym says the members' app is free always, while a paid plan for members is built and waiting
what: The line above the Start my gym form promises 'Your members' app is free, always.' A paid MettleUp Plus plan for members is built, with an owner switch that locks paid extras 7 days after a member's plan ends. Today nothing is locked because the plan is switched off, so the words hold only until that switch is turned on.
expected: The promise to new gyms matches what will happen: the app's basics stay free; some extras can lock after a member's plan ends.
fix_line: Change the line to say logging workouts stays free, or update it on the day the paid plan turns on
